messages.text: I’m not on private browser and I don’t see the Apple Pay button

Then it's usually Wallet: Apple Pay only shows if that iPhone has a card added in Wallet and Settings > Safari > Advanced > Check for Apple Pay is on. Worth a quick look.

If it still won't show, don't lose the unit over it. I can build you a checkout link for the DC06 and you can pay by card or PayPal in a minute.

Do you have a card in Wallet on that phone?
